title: Arc System Works' Donutal Alien Immigration Simulation Game Unveils System Overview
content: Arc System Works revealed on Wednesday during the " ARC SYSTEM WORKS Showcase 2026 - June 24th" livestream a new system overview trailer for its upcoming Donutal game . The game will launch for PC via Steam this year.
author: ANN

title: J.C.Staff Produces 'Nabe ni Dangan wo Ukenagara' TV Anime Adaptation for 2027
content: Production company Kadokawa announced a television anime adaptation of Juntarou Aoki and Shin Moriyama 's Nabe ni Dangan wo Ukenagara ( Getting Shots on Frying Pan ) manga on Thursday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured right). Produced by J.C.Staff , the anime is scheduled to air in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Guilty Gear -Strive- Game Teases Robo-Ky
content: Arc System Works revealed on Wednesday during the " ARC SYSTEM WORKS Showcase 2026 - June 24th" livestream a teaser for the Guilty Gear -Strive- fighting game 's upcoming DLC character Robo-Ky. The full trailer will premiere at EVO 2026 this weekend. Robo-Ky will join the game as part of the season 5 pass.
author: ANN

title: Blazblue: CentralFiction Fighting Game Gets 1st New Character in 9 Years
content: Arc System Works revealed during its " ARC SYSTEM WORKS Showcase 2026" live stream on Wednesday that it will release a new character for its Blazblue: CentralFiction fighting game.
author: ANN

title: In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked Anime Reveals First Trailer, Main Cast, January 2027 Release Date
content: The upcoming TV anime adaptation of In a World Full of Zombies I’m the Only One Who Doesn’t Get Attacked ( Zombie no Afureta Sekai de Ore Dake ga Osowarenai ) has released its first teaser trailer, revealing the main cast and confirming a January 2027 premiere.
author: Anime Corner

title: Makoto Morishita's The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Manga Gets TV Anime in January 2027
content: A website opened on Thursday to announce the television anime adaptation of Makoto Morishita 's The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop ( Sudachi no Maōjō ) manga that will debut in January 2027. The website also revealed a teaser promotional video, teaser visual, and the anime's main cast and staff members.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Sudachi no Maoujou' Gets TV Anime Adaptation For Winter 2027
content: An official website opened for a television adaptation of Makoto Morishita 's Sudachi no Maoujou ( The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop ) manga on Thursday, revealing the main cast, production staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and promotional video. The anime is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Gacha Girls Corps Light Novel Series Gets TV Anime in January 2027
content: A website opened on Thursday to announce that author Chinkururi and illustrator Yasutaka Isegawa 's Gacha Girls Corps ( Gacha o Mawashite Nakama o Fuyasu: Saikyō no Bishōjo Gundan o Tsukuriagero ) light novel series is getting a television anime adaptation that will debut in January 2027.
author: ANN

title: 1 Year Later, Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Finally Gets a Streaming Date (But There’s a Catch)
content: Following the historic success of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle film, fans will finally get to watch it on streaming services. Ufotable announced a trilogy film series to adapt the manga’s most intense arc. So far, only the first installment has been released, and it ran in the theatres for almost a month.
author: ComicBook
